research_question: How did the contemporaneous high-nickel-cathode -> battery-grade lithium-hydroxide demand thesis change across 2018-2019, what mechanisms or caveats drove revisions, and what competing scenarios were knowable at each historical cutoff?

candidate_sources.target_claim: growing high-nickel cathode use supports demand for battery-grade lithium hydroxide
the high-nickel transition progressed more slowly than anticipated and some customers used lower-cost carbonate or lower-performance hydroxide
higher-nickel adoption was still expected to increase lithium-hydroxide need
conservative and optimistic lithium-hydroxide demand scenarios coexist rather than one certain path
the market lacked consensus on hydroxide/carbonate split and faster hydroxide growth depended on higher-nickel adoption

execution_order: Archive exact original source bytes and establish conservative first-known times; use SEC filing timestamps/filing dates as availability bounds where supported.
Extract only claim-scoped Evidence fragments for the hydroxide-demand thesis, revision mechanism/caveats and competing scenarios; do not expand into broad lithium market research.
Persist each contemporaneous thesis/scenario as immutable Judgment assertions with source-supported target precision and explicit rationale/caveat Evidence.

Represent the 2019 Livent negative update with a typed JudgmentRelation REVISES edge to the earlier Livent thesis when the claim identity is sufficiently aligned; otherwise preserve them as distinct Judgments and document why no revision edge is asserted.
Use JudgmentRationale records for source-backed mechanisms/conditions such as slower high-nickel adoption and substitution toward carbonate/lower-performance hydroxide.
Seal a typed PostgreSQL -> DuckDB replay and prove that pre-2019 cutoffs cannot see the later revision/rationales/relations or competing scenarios.

Only after the contemporaneous cognition chain is stable, identify the smallest source-backed later Reality/Outcome needed to evaluate a specific forecast. Do not manufacture an Outcome merely to complete the three-layer shape.

minimum: At least two distinct historical expectation vintages are archived from original or authoritative contemporaneous sources.
At least one source-backed rationale or caveat survives typed PostgreSQL and sealed DuckDB replay.
At least one typed revision relation survives replay if the source semantics justify it.
Competing scenarios remain separate Judgments rather than being collapsed into one hindsight consensus.
Knowledge cutoffs hide every rationale/revision/scenario until its conservative known-time.
No new lithium-specific branch appears in generic replay code.
Existing Kemerton direct Outcome, Kwinana related-milestone Outcome and Kwinana state-as-of Reality regressions remain green.
acceptance.stop_rule: If original evidence does not support a clean revision identity or later Outcome, preserve the ambiguity explicitly and stop rather than infer a false relation or result.
